lines.en: Why is the counter wet and sticky?
Oh, well, they-- I had to--
Wet and sticky is very icky.
Sticky and wet makes Mommy upset.
I don't know how to respond to that.
- Right in here. - Who are these people?
The elderly. They all live in this building.
But why are you bringing them in here?
Every apartment is nearly 100 degrees inside.
Yours is the only one with air conditioning.
Why can't they go somewhere--
When temperatures get too high, the elderly will start to die.
Wow, that's a creepy rhyme.
When a big boy eats his vegetables--
Don't sing this song!
It seems somebody forgot our little rule.
What rule?
Just skip it, all right, Freddy?
Tell her the rule about standing up straight.
You won't get respect if your back's not erect.
